function ready() { return false; }
function valid() { return true; }
const flag = Boolean(1);
console.log(ready && ready());
console.log(ready && (flag && ready()));
if (ready && valid) console.log(ready(), valid());
while (ready) { console.log("loop"); break; }
const subject = { ready };
console.log(subject.ready && subject.ready());
const candidate = ready || valid;
console.log(candidate());
